_comment: Lionett's quest: harvest 8 seaweed on the north shore. Seaweed takes damage only from a `harvest`-tagged aura. Reward on Lionett's turn-in: FirstAid plus the L9 half-level rule at L2. Count and reward [PLACEHOLDER].
title: A Healthy Brew

stages.journal: Lionett wants you to gather 8 seaweed for her tea.
Eight strands of seaweed. Lionett is waiting for them.
Lionett brewed her tea and taught you how to make it.
